Results.Title: Spirit II E-310 best grill we've owned

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Purchased this grill per America’s Test Kitchen’s recommendation. We’ve had it for more than 6 years and it’s great. This replaced another Weber grill that we had for more than 10 years. I do a lot of meal prepping on weekends so I grill several pounds of marinated meats for several days consumption and this grill makes it possible. I recently purchased the griddle insert and love it. Recently, I needed to change the igniter and flavorizer bars, contacted Weber and received the best customer service. Weber ended up sending me the igniter and flavorizer bars for free. Thank you Weber. I highly recommend this grill.
Results.Title: “Best Reliable Grill”

Results.ReviewText: My father brought this grill to replace our very old one. We didn’t realize the designs flaws until after the return period and now, we are unfortunately stuck with this. When you put a cover over the grill, it pushes down the burner buttons. This caused propane to leak overnight. Fortunately, we noticed in the morning and immediately turned the grill off. We have wasted a lot of money on this grill, and now it’s wasting the propane as well. There are other flaws, like how the side tables fold up when you are trying to rotate the grill. Or, how the brush made for the grill gets destroyed easily. Another flaw is how the roof of the grill is always peeling, none of our other grills has done this before. At first, it looked like char from the food we were making, now I’m not so sure. As someone who grills almost daily, this is definitely not the best option to go with. Overall, horrible grill, and waste of money. I would steer clear of this bbq and buy one that won’t leak propane.
Results.Title: Poor Design, Horrible Grill

Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
